source: Inferno IV: Homer, Horace, Ovid, Lucan, Virgil and Dante form the company of six poets

observedStructure.meaning: carbon/life as a correspondence of the assembled six-poet fellowship

invariants: The fellowship contains six poets; it is not a carbon atom
Previous position [6] = Mary / carbon remains the earlier interpretation, and no prior stage is overwritten
No physical chemistry or element synthesis asserted
scientificAnalogy: Carbon is foundational to known biological molecules due to versatile stable covalent bonding; this does not mean all life is carbon itself.

witnesses.b: Dante is admitted as the sixth poet
witnesses.c: The six-member literary structure has a new social identity while its individual members remain unchanged
